contentList.content: Eldritch Apotheosis
Ascend beyond mortal spellcasting. Scales Eldritch Blast from 2 to 10 beams, attaches scaling force damage dice (d4 to d12), and adds up to 2x Charisma modifier per beam across levels 1-20.
Eldritch Blast
Conjure beams of crackling planar force. Scales from 2 to 10 beams, infuses additional force damage dice (1d4 to 1d12), and channels your Charisma modifier as devastating magical power.
Eldritch Awakening (Tier 1)
Awaken your patron's gift. Eldritch Blast begins with 2 beams, each dealing 1d10 Force damage.
Eldritch Resonance (Tier 2)
Your eldritch power surges. Eldritch Blast fires 3 beams and deals an additional 1d4 Force damage per beam.
Eldritch Convergence (Tier 3)
Mastery coalesces into focused ruin. Eldritch Blast fires 4 beams and deals an additional 1d6 Force damage per beam.
Eldritch Transcendence (Epic Tier)
Transcend mortal spellcasting limits. Eldritch Blast scales to 5–6 beams, adds an additional 1d8 Force damage, and adds your Charisma modifier as extra Force damage on hit.
Eldritch Sovereignty (God Tier)
Wield catastrophic otherworldly might. Eldritch Blast scales to 7–9 beams, adds an additional 1d10 Force damage, and retains your Charisma modifier damage bonus per beam.
Eldritch Apotheosis (Capstone)
Ascend to absolute planar mastery. Eldritch Blast unleashes a devastating 10 beams, infuses an additional 1d12 Force damage, and adds up to twice your Charisma modifier as Force damage on hit.
Eldritch Blast: Scaling Force Rider
Eldritch Blast inflicts bonus Force damage scaling with character level (+1d4 at Level 5, +1d6 at Level 10, +1d8 at Level 13, +1d10 at Level 17, +1d12 at Level 20).
Eldritch Charisma Infusion
Upon reaching Level 13, your sheer force of personality augments your Eldritch Blast, adding your Charisma Modifier as bonus Force damage to each beam.
Eldritch Charisma Apotheosis
At Level 20, your connection to the arcane reaches its peak, adding a second instance of your Charisma Modifier as bonus Force damage to each beam (2x Charisma Modifier total).
